lines.text: By a wide, slow river, there was a tall jamun tree.
say: By a wide, slow river, there was a tall jamun tree.

lines.text: Its fruit was small, purple and very sweet.
say: Its fruit was small, purple and very sweet.

lines.text: A little monkey named Kapi lived in the tree.
say: A little monkey named Kapi lived in the tree.

lines.text: He ate jamuns for breakfast, jamuns for lunch, and jamuns for dinner!
say: He ate jamuns for breakfast, jamuns for lunch, and jamuns for dinner!

lines.text: One morning, a big crocodile swam up to the tree. His name was Bobo.
say: One morning, a big crocodile swam up to the tree. His name was Bobo.

lines.text: He looked hungry and a little lonely.
say: He looked hungry and a little lonely.

lines.text: "Hello!" said Kapi. "Would you like some fruit?"
Bobo ate one jamun. "Mmm! Thank you!" he said with a big smile.
say: he said with a big smile.

lines.text: Every day, Bobo came to the tree, and every day, Kapi shared his fruit.
say: Every day, Bobo came to the tree, and every day, Kapi shared his fruit.

lines.text: They told stories. They watched the birds. They laughed and laughed.
say: They told stories. They watched the birds. They laughed and laughed.

lines.text: Kapi and Bobo became the best of friends.
say: Kapi and Bobo became the best of friends.

lines.text: One evening, Bobo took some jamuns home to his wife, Lulu.
say: One evening, Bobo took some jamuns home to his wife, Lulu.

lines.text: Lulu was ill. She felt hot and tired.
say: Lulu was ill. She felt hot and tired.

lines.text: "These are from my friend Kapi," said Bobo.
say: These are from my friend Kapi,

lines.text: Lulu ate the fruit and smiled a little.
say: Lulu ate the fruit and smiled a little.

lines.text: "Bobo," said Lulu softly, "please bring me the heart of the jamun. The heart will make me well."
say: please bring me the heart of the jamun. The heart will make me well.

lines.text: But Bobo was sleepy, and he was not listening carefully.
say: But Bobo was sleepy, and he was not listening carefully.

lines.text: He only heard: "...bring me the heart..."
That night, Bobo could not sleep.
say: That night, Bobo could not sleep.

lines.text: "Whose heart does Lulu want?" he thought.
"The heart of the one who gives the sweet fruit? Kapi's heart? Oh no!"
say: The heart of the one who gives the sweet fruit? Kapi's heart? Oh no!

lines.text: Bobo loved his wife, and Bobo loved his friend. What could he do?
say: Bobo loved his wife, and Bobo loved his friend. What could he do?

lines.text: The next day, Bobo said, "Kapi, come to my home. Lulu wants to meet you."
say: Kapi, come to my home. Lulu wants to meet you.

lines.text: "But I can't swim," said Kapi.
"Sit on my back," said Bobo. "I will carry you."
So Kapi jumped onto Bobo's back, and off they went across the river.
say: So Kapi jumped onto Bobo's back, and off they went across the river.

lines.text: In the middle of the river, Bobo stopped. He felt very sad.
say: In the middle of the river, Bobo stopped. He felt very sad.

lines.text: "Kapi," he said, "I must tell you the truth. Lulu wants your heart."
say: I must tell you the truth. Lulu wants your heart.

lines.text: Kapi was scared. The water was deep, and the bank was far away.
say: Kapi was scared. The water was deep, and the bank was far away.

lines.text: But Kapi did not cry. He thought, and he thought fast.
say: But Kapi did not cry. He thought, and he thought fast.

lines.text: "Oh, Bobo!" said Kapi. "Why didn't you tell me before? I keep my heart up in the jamun tree! Take me back, and I will get it."
say: Why didn't you tell me before? I keep my heart up in the jamun tree! Take me back, and I will get it.

lines.text: Bobo turned around and swam back to the tree.
say: Bobo turned around and swam back to the tree.

lines.text: Kapi jumped from Bobo's back, up, up, up into the branches.
say: Kapi jumped from Bobo's back, up, up, up into the branches.

lines.text: He was safe!
Just then, Lulu came up the river. She felt a little better, and she was cross.
say: Just then, Lulu came up the river. She felt a little better, and she was cross.

lines.text: "Bobo!" she said. "I asked for the heart of the jamun, the seed inside the fruit. The seed is good medicine!"
say: I asked for the heart of the jamun, the seed inside the fruit. The seed is good medicine!

lines.text: Bobo looked at Kapi. Kapi looked at Bobo. Then all three began to laugh.
say: Bobo looked at Kapi. Kapi looked at Bobo. Then all three began to laugh.

lines.text: Kapi dropped the seeds, the little hearts of the fruit, down to Lulu.
say: Kapi dropped the seeds, the little hearts of the fruit, down to Lulu.

lines.text: Soon Lulu was well again, and the three of them were friends forever.
say: Soon Lulu was well again, and the three of them were friends forever.

moral.text: Think fast when you are in danger. Kapi did.
say: Think fast when you are in danger. Kapi did.

moral.text: Listen carefully before you act. Bobo didn't, at first.
say: Listen carefully before you act. Bobo didn't, at first.

moral.text: Be kind, even when someone makes a mistake. Kapi shared his fruit again.
say: Be kind, even when someone makes a mistake. Kapi shared his fruit again.

moral.text: Heart has two meanings: the heart inside your body, and the heart of a fruit, the seed in the middle.
say: Heart has two meanings: the heart inside your body, and the heart of a fruit, the seed in the middle.
